review.reason: The source candidate accurately handles the main reusable BLIK, mandate, Connect, refund, dispute and dated eligibility changes. It nevertheless omits a consequential same-day matrix footnote about the exact Elements plus Checkout Sessions combination, while three proposed concept replacements either repeat that omission, assert a narrower setup_future_usage scope than the cited evidence establishes, or erase unrelated method detail. The worker also cites two additional raw matrices without recording their full read in the receipt.
required_changes: In source-stripe-blik.md's product-support paragraph, state the 2026-11-07 bank-redirects matrix's BLIK Payment Element footnote 4: BLIK is unsupported when using Elements with the Checkout Sessions API (raw/stripe-payments-bank-redirects-2026-11-07.md:28,34). The overview lists Checkout Sessions and Payment Element separately, so its broad cells must not imply that this combined path works. This matters to a reader selecting that exact integration, and the existing raw links do not repair the misleading combined support inference. Add the same path-specific warning to the affected BLIK and bank-redirects concept replacements and Q2's UI qualification.

Revise bank-redirects-blik-api-row so it does not imply setup_future_usage is limited to off_session. The November bank-redirects row says supported and its footnote 1 distinguishes bank-debit types from others (raw/stripe-payments-bank-redirects-2026-11-07.md:43,50); the BLIK overview documents an off-session recurring example (raw/stripe-payments-blik-2026-11-07.md:146) but does not exclude on-session setup. State support as a matrix fact and identify off_session as the documented recurring path without asserting it is the only allowed value.

Narrow bank-redirects-blik-product-boundary to update BLIK while retaining the existing concept's explicit support and collection-method facts for the other methods, dated where needed. The proposed replacement drops the enumerated subscription and Invoicing routes for other methods, which would make those method-selection answers undiscoverable from this concept. Include the BLIK Elements with Checkout Sessions exclusion from the November matrix footnote 4.

The source and concept suggestions rely on raw/stripe-payments-bank-redirects-2026-11-07.md and raw/stripe-bank-redirects-2025.md, but the worker receipt read_ranges does not record either. The worker should fully read both additional authorities and record their actual 1-to-EOF ranges in the corrected receipt.
